chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from one of his companions, reporting it from a man from the general Muslims, who said:
I used to sit in a gathering of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), so by Allah, I had not seen a gathering nobler than his gathering.
He said to me one day, 'From where does the sneeze come out?' So I said, 'From the nose'. So he said to me: 'You are wrong'.
So I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you! From where does it come out?' So he said: 'From the entire body, just as the sperm comes out from the entire body, and its exit is from the urethra'.
Then he said: 'Have you not seen the person when he sneezes, his body parts shake? And the sneezer is safe from death for seven days'.
ai.seo_question: Where does a sneeze originate from according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the metaphysical nature of sneezing by comparing its origin to that of semen, illustrating how a universal bodily essence exits through a specific channel. This narration highlights the Shia understanding of the body as a unified entity where spiritual and physical states intersect, linking the physical act of sneezing to divine protection from death for seven days. The hadith serves as a reminder of the interconnectedness of bodily functions and spiritual well-being in Islamic physiology.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from one of his companions, reporting it from a man from the general Muslims having said,
‘I used to sit in a gathering of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I had not seen a gathering nobler than his<sup>asws</sup> gathering.
He<sup>asws</sup> said to me one day, ‘From where does the sneeze come out?’ So I said, ‘From the nose’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘You are wrong’.

So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! From where does it come out?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘From the entire body, just as the sperm comes out from the entire body, and its exit is from the urethra’.
Then he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Have you not seen the person when he sneezes, his body parts shake? And the sneezer is safe from the death for seven days’.
en.sarwar: 23. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from certain individuals of his people from a man of ‘Ammah (non-Shi ’a) who has said the following:
“I would sit in the meeting place of abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) I swear by Allah that I had not seen any meeting place nobler than his meeting place.
One day he asked me, ‘Where from does sneeze come?’ I said, ‘It comes out of the nose.’ He said, ‘You have got it wrong.’

I then said, ‘May Allah keep my soul in service for your cause, from where does it come?’ The Imam said, ‘It comes from the whole body, just as a reproductive seed comes out of the whole body and its exit is through penis.’
The Imam then asked, ‘Have you noted that when one sneezes his whole body moves and a person sneezing is safe from death for seven days?”’
